title: Which Bleach character are you? Free Bleach quiz — cv.cm
description: Free Bleach quiz: answer 12 questions to find out if you're Ichigo, Rukia, Orihime, Uryu, Chad, Renji, Byakuya or Toshiro. Unofficial Bleach fan quiz, no spoilers, no sign-up.
lede: Protective and stubborn like Ichigo, dutiful like Rukia or cheerful and kind like Orihime? Answer 12 questions to find your Bleach match.
about: Tite Kubo's Bleach ran in Weekly Shōnen Jump from 2001 to 2016, with an anime from 2004 and the Thousand-Year Blood War series since 2022. It follows Ichigo Kurosaki, a teenager who can see ghosts and becomes a Soul Reaper, and the friends and rivals around him: scowling, protective Ichigo; dutiful, no-nonsense Rukia Kuchiki; kind, cheerful Orihime Inoue; proud, precise Uryu Ishida; Yasutora "Chad" Sado, the gentle giant; hot-headed, loyal Renji Abarai; noble, composed Byakuya Kuchiki; and Toshiro Hitsugaya, the youngest captain. This quiz matches you with one of these eight.

Your result names your character and shows your scores for all eight. The questions are about personality, not story events, so there are no spoilers. This is an unofficial fan quiz written for cv.cm. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tite Kubo, Shueisha or Studio Pierrot; the names belong to their owners.

ichigo.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
ichigo.body: You're protective, stubborn and braver than you'd admit. You may scowl at the world, but you'd do anything for your friends and family, and you never back down when someone needs you. You act first and explain later. Let others help you carry the load sometimes.

rukia.name: Rukia Kuchiki
rukia.body: You're dutiful, direct and tougher than you look. You tell people what they need to hear, you take your responsibilities seriously and you push your friends to be their best. You keep some worries to yourself; share them, and your art skills, with the people you trust.

orihime.name: Orihime Inoue
orihime.body: You're kind, cheerful and wonderfully unusual. You see the good in everyone, you bring light to the darkest days and your imagination runs wild, in the kitchen too. Your gentleness is a strength, not a weakness. Remember your own wishes count as much as everyone else's.

uryu.name: Uryu Ishida
uryu.body: You're clever, proud and precise. You plan carefully, you're good with your hands and you hold yourself to high standards. You may act aloof, but you're a loyal friend who always turns up when it matters. Let people help you now and then; it doesn't make you weaker.

chad.name: Chad (Yasutora Sado)
chad.body: You're a gentle giant: calm, quiet and endlessly loyal. You don't fight for yourself, only for the people who need protecting, and you say a lot with very few words. Friends know they can always count on you. Your kindness is your real strength.

renji.name: Renji Abarai
renji.body: You're bold, loyal and full of fire. You charge in, you speak your mind and you've worked hard for everything you have. Your drive to catch up with the people you admire keeps you going. Keep that passion, and think one step ahead now and then.

byakuya.name: Byakuya Kuchiki
byakuya.body: You're composed, dignified and principled. You keep your emotions to yourself, you value honor and tradition and you hold yourself to the highest standards. People may find you distant, but those close to you know how deeply you care. Let them see it more often.

toshiro.name: Toshiro Hitsugaya
toshiro.body: You're mature, focused and wise beyond your years. You keep a cool head, you take responsibility seriously and you don't like being underestimated. You're more caring than you show, and fiercely protective of the people close to you. It's OK to act your age sometimes.
